records.before: ಅವನ ನಿಶ್ವಾಸದಿಂದ ರೂಪಧಾರಿಗಳಾದ ವೇದಗಳು ಹೊರಹೊಮ್ಮಿದವು. ಅವು ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ, ಪ್ರಕಾಶಮಾನವಾದ, ಸಜ್ಜನರ ಗುರುಗಳಾದವು. ॥೨॥
records.source_reading: तस्य निःश्वासतो वेदा निःसृता रूपधारिणः । सर्वज्ञानकराः साक्षाद्भास्वंतो गुरवः सताम् ॥२॥
records.notes: Actual original reads निःसृता, supporting emergence from his breath. The current Kannada already expresses this and the Vedas’ embodied, illuminating, knowledge-giving and teacher roles. No new replacement. The supplied historical निःमृता is not this original’s reading; no conjectural emendation of the original is needed.

records.before: ಭೂಮಿಯ ವಿಸ್ತಾರವು ಐವತ್ತು ಕೋಟಿ ಎಂದು ನಿನಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದೆನು. ನೀರು ಅದರ ಹತ್ತುಪಟ್ಟು; ತೇಜಸ್ಸು ಆ ನೀರಿಗಿಂತ ಹತ್ತುಪಟ್ಟು. ॥೩೮॥
records.source_reading: पंचाशत्कोटिविस्तारः पृथ्व्याः प्रोक्तो मया च ते । आपो दशाधिकास्तस्यास्तेजस्ताभ्यो दशाधिकम् ॥३८॥
records.notes: The original explicitly has fifty crore for earth. Preserve current ಐವತ್ತು ಕೋಟಿ. Comparison10.2 explicitly has पंचकोटिविस्तारो योजनानां समंततः and refers to तस्य देहे, the body of Virāṭ under discussion, rather than repeating पृथ्व्याः. Preserve five crore yojanas there as well. Do not silently harmonize either numeral or declare the two references identical. The original supplies no explicit yojana unit in9.38 itself. Current tenfold interpretation of दशाधिक is retained within the enveloping-layer context; this review does not establish a new cosmographical reconciliation.

records.before: ತೇಜಸ್ಸಿಗಿಂತ ವಾಯು ಹತ್ತುಪಟ್ಟು; ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಆಕಾಶ ಹತ್ತುಪಟ್ಟು. ಆಕಾಶಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಜಾಗ್ರದಭಿಮಾನವು ಹತ್ತುಪಟ್ಟು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ॥೩೯॥
records.source_reading: तस्माद्दशाधिको वायुस्तस्मात्स्वं वै दशाधिकम् । तस्माद्दशाधिकं जाग्रदभिमानं प्रकथ्यते ॥३९॥
records.notes: Important: actual print reads तस्मात्स्वं, not a clear तस्मात्खं. Thus the historical problem is not merely an online typo absent from the original. Context9.43 clearly has खेन वायुः समावृतः and आकाशं, supporting the current sky interpretation, but that is contextual interpretation/emendation rather than a diplomatic reading of39. Current Kannada already includes the waking-ego layer. Retain current text provisionally with an explicit source-reading/meaning flag; do not claim svam→kham has been scan-verified. No new replacement.

records.before: ಇನ್ನು ವಿಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೂಪಗಳ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳು. ಅದು ನಾನಾಭಾವಗಳನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿ, ಚರಾಚರಮಯವಾಗಿ ಇರುವ ಉತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ॥೧೪॥
records.source_reading: अथ शृणु विभिन्नानामुत्पत्तिं त्वल्पभावनाम् । नानाभावधरां तां वै चराचरमयीं पराम् ॥१४॥
records.notes: The original confirms the compressed अल्पभावनाम् expression. The current wording about differentiated small forms is a broad provisional rendering, without narrowing the referents to humans. Preserve its interpretation hold; the scan does not independently settle the exact syntax/force of alpa-bhāva. Do not silently normalize the Sanskrit inflection or introduce a more specific class of beings. No new minimal correction demonstrated.

records.before: ನಮೋ ನಮೋ ಮಹೇಶಾಯ ಶಿವಾಯ ಚಿದಧಾರಿಣೇ । ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸಮಭಾವಾಯ ವಿಷ್ಣವೇ ಪ್ರಭವಿಷ್ಣವೇ ॥೨೩॥
records.source_reading: नमो नमो महेशाय शिवाय शिवदायिने । सर्वत्र समभावाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ॥२३॥
records.proposed_full_replacement: ನಮೋ ನಮೋ ಮಹೇಶಾಯ ಶಿವಾಯ ಶಿವದಾಯಿನೇ । ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸಮಭಾವಾಯ ವಿಷ್ಣವೇ ಪ್ರಭವಿಷ್ಣವೇ ॥೨೩॥
records.notes: Only ಚಿದಧಾರಿಣೇ → ಶಿವದಾಯಿನೇ. Actual original clearly reads शिवदायिने; the remainder of the mantra is unchanged. This correction rests on inspected pixels, not on adopting the historical online quotation.
